title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (helm/terraform) and upgrade/rollback
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: automate tenant RBAC bootstrap and upgrade/rollback hooks for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) so installer (Helm + Terraform) can create least-privilege roles and bindings as part of a repeatable, idempotent install/upgrade flow. This PR adds a new terraform rbac module, Helm chart templates and values for the Private installer, and an installer-side bootstrapper that runs pre-install/post-upgrade hooks. Changes include: - terraform/modules/rbac: module to declare cluster-scoped and namespaced roles/rolebindings, service account bootstrap with configurable scope and annotation for KMS/HSM keys. - charts/private-installer/templates/rbac.yaml: generated Roles, ClusterRoles, RoleBindings, and ClusterRoleBindings for tenant isolation (tenant-<id> namespace patterns) and a bootstrap service account with minimal create/get/patch permissions needed by the installer. - values.yaml additions: rbac.enable, rbac.tenantNamespacePattern, rbac.bootstrapServiceAccount, rbac.allowlistCIDRs. - installer bootstrapper (pkg/installer/bootstrap/rbac.go): idempotent apply logic, retries with exponential backoff, validation checks, and a dry-run mode used by the CI e2e harness. - terraform integration: module usage example in terraform/modules/examples/private-installer and an automated tf plan/apply wrapper for ephemeral service accounts during initial bootstrap. - upgrade/rollback tooling: scripts/upgrade/rollback.sh and installer hooks to revoke bootstrap SA keys after successful rollout and to apply rollback RBAC state on failure. Testing and rollout: includes unit tests for the bootstrapper, integration tests under tests/integration/rbac_bootstrap_test.go that run against kind/k3s clusters in CI, and an e2e smoke test via the private-installer job. Security review: service account scope minimized and auditable annotations added; Snyk scan run and a minor advisory flagged (see CI notes) which was mitigated by pinning an underlying dependency. Backwards compatibility: installer checks for existing roles/bindings and only adds missing resources; documented migration steps included in docs/private/rbac-bootstrap.md. Checklist: - [x] terraform module + examples - [x] helm templates + values - [x] installer bootstrapper + idempotency - [x] upgrade/rollback script hooks - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and runbook - [x] security review notes and pinned dependency
commits: feat(rbac): add terraform rbac module and examples
feat(installer): idempotent RBAC bootstrapper with dry-run mode
chore(helm): add rbac templates and values for private-installer
test(rbac): add integration tests for bootstrap flow
fix(ci): pin transitive dependency to address snyk advisory

release_notes: Automated RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (Helm + Terraform). Adds terraform rbac module, Helm RBAC templates/values, installer bootstrapper, and upgrade/rollback hooks. Provides tenant-scoped roles and a limited bootstrap service account. See docs/private/rbac-bootstrap.md for migration and runbook.
